scope: Existing Inbox, Settings, Privacy, Support, Rewards, Achievements, Progress, Security; scheduling in admin requested; no new player screen
source: Owner Q33-Q37, Q39 brand kit and PN01-PN04 final decisions 2026-11-25

brand.mockup_icon: REAL approved supplied brand icon (not PQ placeholder)
brand.os_icon: OS chooses icon packaged in Android/iOS application; network push cannot replace system icon
brand.android_icon_limitation: Legacy launcher art provided; monochrome status-bar/adaptive icon not yet source-approved or device-tested
brand.ios_icon_limitation: iOS AppIcon asset matrix included; Xcode build test still needed
brand.large_image: only if approved and relevant; do not fabricate art

channels.remote_push: best-effort transport; no guarantee device shows notification; Inbox message preserved
channels.email: only when approved by corresponding transactional account/support flow

player.master_push_toggle: screen12 existing notification toggle; display effective state from OS permission and in-app preference
player.category_preferences: within existing Screen28/40 setting subview, no new player page; never turn on marketing by granting OS permission
player.support_for_guests: Inbox local if authenticated guest identity available; remote only when a valid device token and consent/eligibility exists
player.tap_routes: existing screen ids only; validate account ownership, published content, expiry, and deep link; otherwise open Inbox
player.security: no private payload in lockscreen text

admin.permissions: authorized admin roles only; role names/approval policy to be confirmed
admin.recipient_rule: only pre-existing eligible account audience, no new friend/social/marketing segments; target set must be authorized and consent-filtered
scheduling: Select local wall-clock schedule for each recipient and IANA time zone; persist calculated UTC delivery time
Recompute future deliveries on timezone change and DST
Preview local time per recipient and UTC storage separately
No normal scheduled Push if timezone unknown
Ordinary missed dispatch max 6 hours from original time and subject to validity/quiet/cap
Cancel before dispatch; re-evaluate permission/audience at dispatch
admin.idempotency: logical_notification_id+recipient_id+channel for each delivery; schedule retries must not duplicate
admin.marketing: DISABLED for V1; future not a product feature until separate approval and consent

release_gates: identify live push transport and credentials outside design archive
real Android and iOS permission/channel/deep link tests
device tokens, retry, duplicate and time-zone tests
Brand source raster installed in real Android/iOS build and icon mask tests
PN02 local-zone quiet hours / rolling 24h unit acceptance design
PN03 multi-timezone, DST and changed-timezone tests
PN04 outage, six-hour window, quiet-hour carry, expiry and no-burst tests
FCM Android client config and iOS plist match but actual server credentials, APNs linkage and delivery are not yet verified
Android Google Login OAuth client and signing SHA fingerprints pending verification

PN01.events_type: only when an approved real event exists and is active; launch V1 events none; no scheduled events at launch
PN01.marketing_type_v1: DISABLED; no promotional messages sent; future only after separate explicit user opt-in and policy review

PN02.counting_window: rolling_24h_per_player (24 hours before each dispatch; do not reset at midnight UTC)
PN02.critical_scope: only real critical account/security alerts e.g. verified email change, suspicious login; do not mark rewards/marketing or ordinary system news critical

PN03.scheduled_time_display: recipient_local_timezone; administration preview includes representative example and UTC conversion where relevant
PN03.storage: UTC instants per recipient plus IANA timezone rule and schedule definition; never use fixed offset
PN03.timezone_change: reschedule future unsent deliveries for recipient using newly validated IANA timezone
PN03.dst: recompute with timezone database; handle nonexistent/ambiguous times with explicit tested deterministic technical convention, no owner-selected convention claimed

PN04.lateness_anchor: original scheduled dispatch time for that recipient, not worker retry time
PN04.ordinary_delivery: within six hours only if still relevant, eligible, inside allowed local hours and below rolling cap
PN04.quiet_hour_deferral: next permitted local 08:00 only if still within six-hour grace, event valid and cap permits; otherwise suppress
PN04.expiration: cancel Push for expired event/claim even within six hours
PN04.critical_security: send on recovery only while still relevant and authorized, irrespective of quiet hours/cap
PN04.burst_protection: do not send backlog in bulk; stable idempotency and eligibility recheck
PN04.inbox: persist independently when still meaningful; do not delete underlying reward/progress when Push canceled
